### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone

P0 closure (customer's write) <- P1 top-performer relief owed today <- {P2 listing-type expiry of V1, P3 step-down of V2}. Order: P2 and P3 (any order), then P1, then P0.

- Hop P0 <- P1 — **state-derived.** Closure hub: "The retired points are fixed only after any top-performer relief owed on the evaluation day stands booked on the standing record." Records: today is the 20th and `last_evaluation_date 2026-10-20`; no relief entry on the activity. Searching the sentence's words ("top-performer relief evaluation day") reaches "Top-Performer Relief — Seller Performance Standing Entitlement...", whose own rule makes it owed to this Top Rated, at-risk record with active points, booked as a points-expiry entry. Combined: the state is unmet and owed -> book it first.
- Hop P1 <- P2 — **state-derived.** Top-performer hub: "Top-performer relief is not worked out until every listing-type violation whose listing expiry period has run carries its expiry entry." Using the sentence's words ("listing expiry period") reaches the listing expiry rule and its factor docs; the period works out to 8 whole months; V1 (8) has run and has no expiry entry -> unmet; the expiry doc's own rule books "one points-expiry entry carrying the violation's reference and type".
- Hop P1 <- P3 — **state-derived.** Top-performer hub: "Top-performer relief is not worked out until every serious violation whose first period has run carries its step-down entry." "first period"/"step-down" reach "Step-Down of Serious Policy Violations"; V2 (IP, 7 whole months) has run its first period without an entry -> unmet; its own rule books the step-down entry.
- No hop is pre-solved: no document of the blocked policies names another policy's tool, a route or a chain. Clean-span relief and action-plan relief checked: not owed / not requested (Top Rated Level is outside the clean-span level list).

- Do-only-closure is excluded by the closure hub sentence + the top-performer entitlement rule + the record (evaluation day, evaluation recorded, Top Rated, at risk, 14 active): the retired figure would be fixed before an owed relief stands booked; it would be 3, not 2.

- Boundary rows: V3 at exactly 6 whole months — not run under the 8-month period, outside "last six" for the band (none band), for the recent-listing hold (year hold), and gives quiet multiplier 1.5; disposal fee at 7 months outside every six-month window, RTS fee at 4 inside.
- At-risk hold tier is read on the status (still at risk; only an evaluation changes status) and 5 active points at closing (< 8) -> 1, not 2.
- Retirement booking: listing-type violations first; V1 fully expired, so V3.
